known_static_proof_limits: JSON Schema draft 2020-12 permits unbounded array indices and optional process_status properties, so static coverage is proved over a generated path-pattern and union-variant manifest rather than enumerating every concrete instance index.
The manifest proves schema-shape ownership, not semantic equivalence of two feature providers or model sensitivity.
normalizedError nullable members require value-type refinement inside an error-bearing union variant; the checker makes STRING and NULL subvariants explicit.

The current collector schema is closed, but its canonical JSON number token bytes are not retained after ordinary parsing; byte-exact JSON_RATIONAL conformance remains a release-level parser obligation.

The receipt schema is only a structural/union enumerator, not an admissibility contract: duplicate keys/path/PID, ordering, truncation observability, timing direction, canary provenance/hash-length consistency, visible-canary completeness, and producer-vs-schema cap differences require a separate semantic admission validator and explicit producer/admission policy.
C01-C05 model column eligibility and deterministic-math bytes are outside this routing candidate and remain formal blockers.
This routing candidate binds the repaired primitives bytes, but independent feature-provider byte conformance, semantic admission, C01-C05 model layout, G and empirical power remain blocked.
